title: User Centric Design
definition: A design philosophy that focuses on the needs, behaviors, and abilities of users to enhance the usability and satisfaction of a product or service.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as designing with the end user in mind. It's like making a cake: you consider the tastes and preferences of the people who will eat it.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: User-centric design involves understanding user goals, behaviors, and needs to create an intuitive, accessible interface. This is done through user research, usability testing, and iterative design.
difficulty_levels.expert: User-centric design is a philosophical approach that goes beyond functionality to consider the human experience. It explores the intersection of technology, aesthetics, and ethics. This approach has philosophical implications, connecting to fields like artificial intelligence ethics and human-robot interaction.

extra_fields.insight: The NoMatch component should be designed with the user in mind, focusing on usability and satisfaction.
